objectClass.notes: An original Eastbrook board using a familiar medieval civic archetype without copying a third-party crest, silhouette, writing, or decorative composition.

reasoning: The broad board silhouette is simple, but its identity depends on twin floor-seated posts, a deep cobalt rain hood, front and rear timber framing, and open ground clearance.
Repeated shingles, parchment cards, pins, metal corner plates, and stone courses need bounded deterministic systems rather than independent draw calls.
Rear and grazing views expose the roof brackets, rear rails, board depth, and footing contacts needed for a complete three-dimensional asset.
Named interaction and content sockets let future wiring target the board without coupling gameplay to mesh order.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A flat board card would fail the roof depth, rear bracing, post separation, stone seating, and future interaction contract.

definitionOfDone: The complete accepted 2.4 by 0.6 by 2.6 yard volume reads as an original Eastbrook civic noticeboard from every admitted angle and beside the 2.6-yard player rig.
Twin posts, two stone footings, deep cobalt rain hood, timber frame, blank parchment cards, restrained gold hardware, and rear braces survive Low-tier rendering.
The result stays within the 1,500 triangle target and 2,500 triangle hard ceiling with two merged primitives, two materials, zero embedded textures, and zero animations.
Named interaction and notice-surface sockets plus a compound collider contract remain stable for future gameplay wiring.
requiredRepeatedSystems: The front roof uses deterministic cobalt shingle courses with bounded row variation.
Seven blank parchment cards use a fixed asymmetric layout with no readable pseudo-text.
Pins and corner plates are merged repeated details with no independent draw calls.
Two stone footing courses use offset joints and remain centered beneath the posts.
requiredMaterialLayers: One merged surface vertex-color material and one merged hardware material carry independent semantic zones and share the external Eastbrook atlas.
The board response remains legible without bloom, AO, dynamic shadows, embedded maps, or more than two materials.
blockingFailureModes: The prop collapses into a facade card or loses the deep roof and rear bracing.
Posts or footings float, intersect the board, or create implausible ground seating.
Parchment contains readable text, tiny pseudo-text, logos, or a recognizable third-party crest.
The interaction standing point falls inside the collider or behind the board.
The asset requires embedded PBR maps or exceeds any hard budget.
A critical feature scores below 0.7 even when the aggregate review score passes.
